reviewer_statement: Provisional developer-reviewed source scientific graphics geometry on actual native R sparse joint PACE models, verified in committed tests against exact Matplotlib 1.2 data/artists (not observed green yet). R base graphics is not Matplotlib and runtime plotting return types, colors and injected axes remain outside the accepted scoped scientific domain. No independent certification.
native_language_semantic_policy: Native R scientific artist geometry implements source line/image/scatter coordinates, layout, common color limits, titles, labels and failure markers. The renderer uses R base graphics and cannot return actual Python Matplotlib axes or guarantee pixel-identical output; its typed plot metadata explicitly reports matplotlib_object_identity=false.

case_evidence.description: Frozen Python public src/eyetrajectoriespy/sparse_multivariate_plotting.py::plot_sparse_mfpca_score_diagnostics. Per-curve source PACE joint Gaussian score covariance condition-number scatter and explicit nonfinite failures

Real fitted native paired sparse MFPCA scientific record with score_diagnostics columns n_time_points, condition_number and status_code. Strict source geometry records finite successful and flagged points, and an empty nonfinite/failed Matplotlib-style scatter collection when any system is nonfinite; empty and all nonfinite input valid as in Python source.

Native source uses exactly recorded joint PACE conditional system matrix conditioning, not new/unqualified scores; scatter x=n_time_points and y=condition_number, finite mask np.isfinite both, okay statuses code=='ok', flagged otherwise. Python public scatter collection get_offsets on same diagnostic data is the frozen numerical geometry oracle; native base R now renders all-nonfinite or empty scores without throwing away the scientific failure semantics.

Rejects missing required diagnostics columns and invalid status-code class/nonlogical strict flag; source valid all-nonfinite diagnostics now yield an empty native figure and failure legend rather than errors. Python class identity and backend exceptions remain different.

One-panel native strict source artist record contains Matplotlib-source scatter collection labels, paired-point offsets and empty nonfinite/failed placeholder, axes labels and title; default R backend returns finite diagnostics with failure counts. It is not a Python Matplotlib Axes class and native glyph pixels may differ.

Visual diagnosis of the numerical conditioning and explicit failed/nonfinite status of each actual joint PACE conditional score-system solve, including unsuccessful attempts, without conflating missing points with successful fitting.

independent_review_status: Scoped developer review only; exact-head CI and pinned Matplotlib differential are queued or unverified, no independent scientific contract certification.
language_specific_limits: Matplotlib Axes and Figure identity, external axes injection, and pixel-exact `coolwarm` rendering cannot be implemented by a native base-R graphics return.
Accepted source parity is restricted to fitted scientific array values, line/scatter points, image extents/color limits, metadata and failure geometry, not complete Python graphics objects.
Native result remains a real fitted R scientific object; Python class identity and exact error classes are not interchangeable.
No green exact-head CI observed, independent certification, main-branch merge, or CRAN readiness is claimed.
